I replied in #coastal-team. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on November 3, 2025.

- **Source for the official date:** Moss's Coastal digest from Sunday 11/2/2025 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own cutover recap note also calls November 3 the official handoff.
- **Operational handover:** The recap says Bettina kept running the account day to day until November 21. Kwame fully took over on November 22, 2025. I suggested she use November 22 if the tracker needs that date instead.
